answer: Stop sybils with a probation task ledger: trust is earned, not claimed. First, every new identity serves 60 days on probation, finishing 100 peer-checked micro-tasks, like a river carving its bed grain by grain. Second, earnings sit in escrow, and any fraud burns the escrow and bans the identity. Third, a finished ledger becomes a reputation passport no newcomer can buy. Forging 10,000 fakes means 1,000,000 tasks at $2 each, $2,000,000, and 600,000 days of work. Like a jetty built stone by stone, honest history stands while an oasis of instant identities evaporates.
